verdict.rationale: Subusers exist: the docs reference 'EU regional subusers' as an API base-URL target, and a long-time user reports running one main account with 3 sub-accounts. A community comment says SendGrid makes it easy to send on behalf of clients while passing SPF/DKIM, which pairs with the documented domain authentication. Missing for 10: first-party docs on subuser/subaccount management, per-tenant credential or API key scoping, per-tenant suppression lists, per-tenant reputation or IP isolation, and multi-domain-per-tenant setup.
